title: Operator privilege profile
description: The privilege an operator ASKS FOR, read from its shipped manifests: workloads and their host/privilege posture, the RBAC rules its bundle declares, the SCCs it requests and ships, and the install modes its OperatorGroup allows. This is a DECLARED-STATE profile -- it is parsed from manifests in the repository and never from a live cluster, so it answers 'what would this grant if installed' and not 'what is granted right now'. Runtime SCC assignment needs a separate capture and is out of scope by design.

tier.description: Which capture tiers this profile covers, stated in prose because the boundary matters when reading any count here: static manifest tiers only, unless a runtime capture was folded in.

rbac_rules.description: The policy rules the bundle declares, as parsed. Kept whole because a least-privilege review reads the actual rule, not a count of rules.

rbac_flags.description: Rules matching a high-privilege pattern, grouped by pattern. A key is present ONLY when it matched, so an absent key means no match rather than unknown.

rbac_write.description: Write access to RBAC itself. Distinct from escalate/bind because it is a slower path to the same place.

escalate_bind_impersonate.description: The three verbs that let a principal grant itself more than it holds. The highest-signal group here.

sccs_shipped.description: SCC objects the bundle ships. Shipping an SCC is not the same as requesting one, and the two are counted separately for that reason.

install_modes.description: Which OperatorGroup install modes the CSV permits. AllNamespaces is the one that turns a namespaced ask into a cluster-wide one.

tier2_required_vs_granted.description: Kubebuilder RBAC markers in source compared with what the bundle actually ships. `shipped_not_declared` is privilege present in the bundle with no marker asking for it.

example_or_test_manifests_excluded.description: What was deliberately left out. Recorded because a profile that silently swallowed sample manifests would report privilege the operator never asks for in production.

privileged_or_host_workloads.description: Workloads asking for privileged mode or a host namespace. The headline least-privilege number.

distinct_rule_triples.description: Distinct (apiGroup, resource, verb) triples. The de-duplicated size of the ask -- rule COUNT inflates with how the bundle is authored, this does not.

no_scc_request_recorded.description: True when no SCC request was found. Explicitly distinct from an empty request list, because 'asked for nothing' and 'we could not tell' must not read the same.

name.description: Null for a manifest fragment that patches a workload without naming it -- kustomize patches and sidecar overlays. Measured: 32 such workloads across the live corpus. Always a STRING when present: a Kubernetes name is an RFC 1123 label, and a producer must coerce it, because YAML parses an unquoted `name: 0` as an integer while `name: "0"` on the same object is a string.
